## About
Austin Texas Mechanic is a working shop on N Lamar Blvd. You won't find a fancy waiting room here, just people who fix tires, exhaust systems, AC and the basics at fair prices.
As one reviewer put it, here you are paying for the basic repairs rather than for a fancy waiting room. We like it that way, and we think you will too.
We're open Monday through Saturday and closed Sunday. Stop by or give us a call.

## Services
- Tire service: Tire replacements, leak checks and air for low tires. One customer called us their go-to tire and muffler shop for years.
- Exhaust systems: One reviewer said exhaust systems seem to be our specialty.
- AC work: One customer recommended us for AC work at a good price.

## FAQ
Q: Do you handle oil changes and brakes?
A: Yes. One reviewer has had oil changes and brake adjustments done here along with tire replacements.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No. We're open Monday through Saturday and closed on Sunday.

## What customers say
- "I needed my AC evacuated to work on my AC lines. Jiffy Lube claims they cant evacuate it without recharging it at the same time. Another shop couldn’t quote me a price without coming in. I called Austin Texas Mechanic, and within 1 minute was told they could do it and got quoted for $180. Despite the rain, they still took me in and evacuated my AC with no problem. Other people in the shop were running out in the rain to talk to other cars pulling up. After doing my wrenching I brought it back and they were ready in seconds to recharge it. Not once did they complain or make me feel bad for coming to the shop. They smiled as I confirmed the AC was working. If you need AC work or Tires for a good price and great service, this is the place." (Marcos Perez, 5/5)
